description: Prices and recording guide for a custom voice (Piper TTS) that sounds like the user: they read short sentences in the browser and Ania trains the model. Use it to explain the steps (~15 min minimum; recording_tips has the easy phone setup) before create_voice. Charges nothing.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

voice_language.description: Language the person will read and the voice will speak: pt-BR or en-US.
